clare: Heads-up: all-hands tomorrow 11:00am PT in the main room. Short agenda below. Please drop up to two questions here or use the form.

clare: Agenda (est)
- 11:00-11:05 company pulse: hires + runway + one win
- 11:05-11:15 Cloud Edge pilot launch details (product + eng)
- 11:15-11:25 Data residency & privacy policy pilot (legal + security)
- 11:25-11:30 Dedicated outage recap + actions (SRE)
- 11:30-11:40 Live Q&A (we'll prioritize pre-submitted)

clare: Recording + one-pager will be posted after; calendar event already has a placeholder for recording.

eric: Edge pilot: cohort-based. initial cohort = 5 customers (mix of dedicated & private). Console will show pilot perf baselines under Pilot Labs.

tal: Ops checklist snippet:
```
- -7d: infra prep (eu-west, us-west)
- -3d: internal smoke + perf runs
- 0d: onboard cohort
- +7d: monitor & iterate
```

tal: We'll enable KV-prefix caching for pilot workloads by default; expect ~15-30% token cost reduction for common chat patterns.

mira: Policy highlight: project-level enforced data-region is being piloted behind a feature flag. Legal + security to finalize customer-facing wording before GA.

mira: Quick ask to teams: any regulatory/compliance blockers we should flag now? Reply here or use the form: https://forms.gle/rdw-allhands-questions

lina: Incident recap preview: root cause was an autoscaler race combined with a driver mismatch. Short-term mitigation: circuit breaker + stricter canaries. Adding an SLO alert for cross-AZ tail latency.

clare: If you want a specific question asked live, paste it here with your team tag (e.g., "infra: rollback plan?"). Execs prefer 1-2 pre-submitted ones.

devops-bot: :calendar: Invite + recording placeholder created and shared company-wide.

eric: If you'll demo, send slides to me by EOD. Keep demos <=3 slides.

clare: Thanks all. See you tomorrow! :rocket:
